text: He's made a world of wonders! He rolled up his sleeves, He set things right.
He showed the world what he could do.
To his dear family, Israel—indefatigable love. The whole earth comes to attention. Look—God's work of salvation!
Let loose and sing! Strike up the band!
Fill the air with praises to King God.
With everything living on earth joining in.
When he comes to set the earth right. He'll straighten out the whole world, He'll put the world right, and everyone in it.
